messages:
maya-ml: Quick alert 1: the q6b-int8 candidate shows a consistent drop on the 'edge-lane' longsumm slice during onboarding evals. Not huge but reproducible (~4.5 rougeL).

leo-curation: Can you confirm which promptset + dedupe params we used? could be a sampling artifact.

maya-ml: Using promptset longsumm_v3 (22k examples). We applied cheap semantic dedupe at 0.8 last Friday to reduce duplicates before seedbanking.

nina-labelops: If dedupe removed paraphrase anchors that anchored gold labels, that would explain brittleness. We can run a microgolden refresh focused on the edge-lane behaviors.

ash-eng: Also could be decoding differences introduced by the int8 kernels. I want to run an isolated A/B on the slice with identical decoding seeds and temperature.

maya-ml: Eval command used: 
```bash
python eval/run.py --model q6b-int8-candidate --dataset datasets/longsumm_v3.jsonl \
  --slice edge_lane --metric rougeL --batch 16 --seed 2024 --decoding greedy
```

ci-bot: CI note: q6b-int8-candidate build succeeded at 2024-06-18T14:04:11Z. Perf: 560 tok/s. KV footprint 1.1GB/slot.

leo-curation: Proposal: create microgolden of 400 examples (200 golden anchors + 200 review) sampled from edge_lane stratified by multi-paragraph length. Also preserve any near-duplicates removed by dedupe (soft restore) for comparison.

nina-labelops: I can spin that batch up. Requesting permission to add 450 to label quota for two days to avoid backlog. Also will add a special checklist: mark out-of-order facts, missing transitions, and compression hallucinations.

ash-eng: Meanwhile I'll run the A/B baseline vs candidate on that microgolden only. If gap persists it's likely quant-kernel related. If gap narrows, it's probably sampling/golden corruption.

maya-ml: One more instrument we should add: token-diff traces for the top 3 beams and an alignment scorer for reference spans. I'll push a small patch to the eval harness. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/412

ci-bot: Eval job queued: job_id=job-edge-1746123456, shards=4. Expect results ~45m.

leo-curation: For traceability, open a tracker: RDW-8274 and attach the microgolden plan + sampling seed. I'll also include a small human-readable rubric for labelers.

nina-labelops: Label instructions (short):
- mark TRUNC if summary misses final paragraph
- mark ORDER if chronology is wrong
- mark HALL if invented entities/facts
- highlight minimal span for error
(Full doc linked in RDW-8274)

maya-ml: Uploaded a quick batch of 50 failing examples and 50 matched controls to the ticket for eyeballing. :eyes:

ci-bot: AB results posted: candidate vs baseline on microgolden: baseline up by 4.7 rougeL (p=0.011). Token-diff logs: /evals/job-edge-1746123456/logs.tar.gz

ash-eng: Ok that's statistically significant. I'll run a kernel bisect and also re-run with forced fp16 math flag to check runtime numeric divergence.

leo-curation: Given that, let's proceed with the microgolden relabel and a small quant calibration sweep (per-sample importance weighting on long contexts). We'll do them in parallel.

nina-labelops: Label batch queued. ETA artifacts ~36h. I'll post updates and link gold artifacts here when done.

maya-ml: Thanks team. After labels return I'll run the full regression harness and then plan a staged rollout if resolved. Adding action items: (1) leo create RDW ticket + attach seeds, (2) nina schedule label batch, (3) ash run kernel bisect + fp16 check, (4) maya run post-relabel evals.

leo-curation: Ticket RDW-8274 created and pinned to eng-ml board. Added sampling script and dedupe whitelist to preserve anchors.

nina-labelops: Labelers started; will keep short standup updates. :white_check_mark:
